item.title: [Malayalam] [OTT Release] Kappi Squad
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageMalayalam
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date15 Oct 2026

Kappi Squad is a Malayalam comedy-drama that revolves around four emotionally unfinished young adults. Grappling with their own insecurities, egos, and wounded pride, they decide to channel their energies into an unlikely venture: a café business. The series explores their journey as they navigate the challenges of entrepreneurship while also confronting their personal demons and seeking validation.
